description: JavaScript code for managing PriceBooks in vtiger CRM, including functions for adding products to price books, updating list prices, validation, and AJAX operations.

methods.name: addtopricebook
methods.description: Adds selected products to a price book, validating list prices and preparing form submission.

methods.name: updateListPrice
methods.description: Updates visibility and value of list price input based on checkbox state.

methods.name: check4null
methods.description: Validates that the product name field is not empty.

methods.name: set_return_specific
methods.description: Sets vendor information in the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_inventory_pb
methods.description: Sets list price in the opener window's form.

methods.name: deletePriceBookProductRel
methods.description: Deletes a product-price book relation via AJAX.

methods.name: verify_data
methods.description: Validates the list price field before form submission.
